overview_description.description:
OneCard (万卡) is a Chinese service provider that enables the integration of all megacards into one card, which supports the secure backup of the users’ bank cards, credit cards, deposit cards, and membership cards. 

OneCard is a consumer electronic product with independent intellectual property rights. Through the invention of the patent electro-magnetic head's inductor, the reliability of its megacard identification has greatly improved.

product.description: Services that allow users to add balance to their OneCard accounts through various payment methods including bank transfers, credit cards, PayPal, and mobile phone balance.

product.description: Prepaid cards for online games, mobile recharge, voice and data services, entertainment, and other digital services available for purchase through OneCard.
